items.title: Could Monolithic Power Stock Drop 30% Again?
items.summary: The one number a Monolithic Power Systems holder should watch is free cash flow. That is the cash left after running the business and paying for new equipment. Over the twelve months to September 2026 it came to $606 million, down from $705 million a year earlier. Revenue rose 40.5% over the same twelve months.

items.title: What Could NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) New Robotics Platform Mean For Investors?
items.summary: NXP Semiconductors (NasdaqGS:NXPI) has introduced a unified robotics platform based on its Neural Axis Architecture for AI-enabled autonomous systems. The platform offers a validated development environment and modular SDK aimed at secure, real-time use across a range of robotics applications.
